name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Implementation Manager | Field Service SaaS Onboarding, Configuration, Data Migration & Training
summary: Implementation manager who knows the businesses on the other side of the platform. Through Solenzo I build CRM, booking, and automation systems for home-services trades (HVAC, plumbing, electrical), and at Birdeye I onboarded reseller partners across home services, health, and retail. At Wix I launched 25+ clients a month with up to ~25 in flight at 110% of implementation targets. I configure the system, migrate and validate the data, train the team, and spot the upsell when it fits.

experience.title: Implementation Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Lead onboarding for home-services clients (HVAC, plumbing, electrical) from discovery to go-live: custom configuration, workflow setup, forms, booking, and live training for owners and staff.
Migrate and validate client data into GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Salesforce, re-checking every import, and build integrations through Zapier, Make, n8n, webhooks, and APIs.
Built a 20+ workflow automation system covering lead capture, booking with confirmations and reminders, no-show recovery, onboarding, reactivation, and review requests.
Identify expansion opportunities and scope complementary services for existing clients, and document every system so clients can run it themselves.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and trained 15-20 reseller partners across home services, health, and retail (deals ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94%), and fed structured feedback to Product and Engineering.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Served a banking-industry client and helped pursue a major banking prospect in the northeastern U.S., reaching finalist stage.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Implemented and launched 25+ clients per month with up to ~25 concurrent onboardings, holding 110% of implementation targets and delivering launches on schedule.
Led multiple onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists, running weekly training sessions, workshops for new initiatives, and 1:1 coaching.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Walked clients through Accelo's invoicing and billing features, showing how time, projects, and billing connect in one system.
Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and guided onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
